audit_item: A13/A14 / Train-only Stage59/60/M3.3 preregistration and Stage69 source scope integrity
finding: The Stage59/60 and M3.3 preregistration generators permissively parsed frozen configs/reports, while the Stage69 episode-reset tool permissively parsed its preregistration, config, and source completion marker before registering and reading Train windows. Duplicate keys could change the effective scope or evidence fields despite matching raw-byte hashes.
change: All three preregistration readers now use recursive duplicate-key rejection and require object roots. Stage69 now applies the strict parser to its frozen preregistration, config, and source marker before data registration/read. Errors fail closed under ValueError or DataError. Added temporary duplicate-field, invalid UTF-8, and wrong-root tests for all four readers.

verification.pytest: stage preregistration/scope, M3/M1.3 analyzer, runner, and inventory selector: 70 passed, 1 skipped (host symlink capability)
verification.ruff: passed for modified preregistration and Stage69 scripts
verification.mypy: packages qa: 224 source files, no issues; installed untyped-wheel diagnostic disabled

data_scope: Only synthetic JSON fixtures were read. No preregistered Stage artifacts, Train rows, ledger, Validation, Test, or Holdout were opened.
replay_boundary: Changing preregistration or runner source hashes invalidates reuse of their previous frozen source identity; do not replay consumed Train windows.
